profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II (SE4)
profile.summary: Although I am a self-taught web and software developer, I work every day to expand my knowledge and master my craft. Not because I have to, but because I have a passion for building useful products. Now with 7+ years of profession experience as a Software Engineer in a the full spectram of company sizes, I have a breadth of technical knowledge to bring to the table. I specialize in all things Frontend but have 3+ years working on backend / data systems as well. Reach out to me if you have an exciting opportunity to build something amazing together.
